canonical_question: Is the '10 ± 0.8 GPa' nanopillar strength value derived from the same sample set as the '19 ± 2.3 GPa' hardness?

answers.answer: The text states: 'The CuMoTaWV RHEA film showed an average hardness and nanopillar compressive strength of 19 ± 2.3 and 10 ± 0.8 GPa, respectively'. This phrasing implies the values are derived from the same film description, though the specific sample ID is not differentiated in the text.
answers.boundary_limitation: No distinct sample IDs provided to confirm separate sets.
evidence_spans: In this work, a refractory high-entropy alloy (RHEA) film of equimolar CuMoTaWV was deposited on silicon and 304 stainless-steel substrates using DC-magnetron sputtering.
A sputtering target was developed by partial sintering of an equimolar powder mixture of Cu, Mo, Ta, W, and V using spark plasma sintering.
The target was used to sputter a nanocrystalline RHEA film with a thickness of ∼900 nm and an average grain size of 18 nm.
